## Development & Documentation Policies
- Educational Approach: Spiral Learning & The Bicycle Rule (hands-on active coding).
- Documentation: Every single folder in the workspace must have a dedicated, non-boilerplate README.md with native Mermaid diagrams.
- Clean Root: All Python utility/maintenance scripts must reside in `scripts/` with `scripts/README.md`.
- Testing: All Pytest suites are centralized in `/tests/`.
- Jupyter Notebooks: Located in `clase-XX-.../notebook/` with Google Colab badges.
